description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a dedicated nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development within a supportive environment. If you are passionate about delivering high-quality healthcare and fostering a culture of excellence, we encourage you to apply.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and maintaining the highest standards of resident care. You will play a crucial role in staff management, training, and fostering a collaborative and positive work environment. This position offers a competitive salary and the chance to lead a compassionate and skilled team.
requirements: Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations.
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: We are offering a competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
